protocol.members: sequential encoder forwards; per-member clip/frame fusion; left-to-right fp32 sum then fp32 reciprocal; top-k after average
protocol.query_input: shared original RoBERTa features already on GPU, no feature extraction or H2D in timers
protocol.encode_timer: only GMMFormerV2 encode_query forward, once per involved member, no normalization
protocol.search_timer: pre-encoded normalized queries; resident index, all members fused before top-k/merge
protocol.end_to_end_timer: direct measurement of N query forwards, query L2 normalization, and ensemble scoring/top-k
protocol.singleton: first selected Stage C/D expanded-library query; crop input to its valid length
protocol.batch128: same 128 evenly spaced dev IDs as Stage C/D, original masks and padding
protocol.capacity: physically allocate all member indexes and run one B128 retrieval for each fusion; actual CUDA OOM recorded; no theoretical skips
protocol.interference: exit CUDA process, discard all configs and rewait continuous 300s
